subject: Initial discovery + demo — coordination and attendees
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@medpoint.io>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-01T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Initial discovery + demo — coordination and attendees

Hi Samir,

Great to meet you briefly on the call yesterday — thanks for making time. As discussed, we'd like to schedule a 60-minute discovery + live demo to:

- Understand your primary inference workloads and SLAs
- Walk through Redwood's serving and routing model for multi-tenant pipelines
- Surface security/compliance and procurement next steps

Who we'd like on the call from our side: me (AE), Connor O'Brien (SE lead), and Evelyn Hart (Sales Manager — joining as needed). From your side, can you confirm you'll include the engineering lead who owns deployment (you mentioned Lena) and a procurement/contact who manages PO approvals?

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue Nov 3, 9:00–10:00am
- Tue Nov 3, 1:00–2:00pm
- Wed Nov 4, 11:00–12:00pm

If none of these work, send two times that do. I'll attach a short agenda + a one-pager so you can share with Lena/procurement.

Attachments: redwood-discovery-agenda.pdf (1 page), redwood-demo-pack.pdf (5 slides)

Thanks — looking forward.

Laura Bennett
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
https://redwood.ai
From: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@medpoint.io>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@medpoint.io>, procurement@medpoint.io
Date: 2026-11-01T18:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial discovery + demo — coordination and attendees

Thanks Laura — appreciate the agenda. A few notes from our side:

- Tue Nov 3 is tight; our engineering lead (Lena) is only available after 3pm PT that day.
- Wed Nov 4 at 11am PT looks promising, but procurement will likely only sit in for the demo summary (they need to handle PO paperwork post-demo). Please expect procurement to ask for: SOC 2 type II report, data handling summary, and standard SLAs.
- I can join as the internal champion.

Can we do Wed Nov 4, 11:00–12:00 PT? If you need Lena earlier for a short pre-call (15–20m) to go over network/firewall questions, she can do Tue Nov 3, 4:15–4:35pm PT.

Also: procurement will want a short cost ballpark to justify the demo engagement. Can you include high-level pricing ranges in the deck?

Samir
Director of AI Platforms | MedPoint Health
samir.gupta@medpoint.io | +1 212-555-8899

-----
Note: procurement contact is procurement@medpoint.io (team inbox).
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@medpoint.io>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, procurement@medpoint.io
Date: 2026-11-02T08:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial discovery + demo — coordination and attendees

Perfect — Wed Nov 4, 11:00–12:00 PT is locked on our side. I've attached an updated agenda that includes a brief cost slide (high-level ranges + optional Dedicated/Private notes). Connor will run the demo and cover architecture.

Connor: can you review the network/egress bullets below and confirm if we need anything from MedPoint ahead of the session? If Lena can do a 15-minute prep on Tue 4:15–4:35pm PT, Connor can join that short tech sync too.

Network/egress bullets (for Lena):
- Outbound TLS to redwood-serving.redwood.ai on 443 for API traffic
- Optional SSH/port access only for on-prem proof-of-concept (we can avoid this if you prefer)
- If you have a proxy, Connor will provide the env vars we require for the demo call

Attachments: redwood-discovery-agenda.pdf (updated), redwood-demo-pack.pdf

Thanks — I'll send a calendar invite once procurement confirms their attendee.

Laura

--
Laura Bennett | Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@medpoint.io>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@medpoint.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-02T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial discovery + demo — coordination and attendees

Hi Samir / Lena —

Thanks for looping me in. Confirming: I can run the demo Wed Nov 4, 11:00–12:00 PT. Quick notes on the short pre-call (Tue 4:15–4:35pm PT): I'm available and happy to do a 15-minute tech sync to confirm firewall/egress and which dataset (sanitized) you'll want us to use for the live run.

A couple of items to help the demo go smoothly:
- If you can open outbound TLS to redwood-serving.redwood.ai:443, that covers API traffic.
- If you expect larger sequences (clinical notes), let me know expected token lengths so I can pick the right batching profile.
- If procurement needs an internal contact for SOC 2 or security questionnaire, tag Evelyn (evelyn.hart@redwood.ai) — she'll provide the SOC2 summary and compliance packet.

Feel free to send any firewall/proxy info to me directly. I'll prepare a 20-minute architecture walkthrough + 25-minute live demo + 15-minute Q&A.

Connor O'Brien
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai

From: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@medpoint.io>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@medpoint.io>, procurement@medpoint.io
Date: 2026-11-03T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial discovery + demo — coordination and attendees

Thanks all — Wed Nov 4, 11:00–12:00 PT confirmed on our calendar. Lena will join both the prep on Tue 4:15pm PT and the main session. Procurement confirmed they'll attend the final 10–15 minutes and will follow up after the demo with next steps for the PO.

For the prep call: Lena will share an internal hostname and proxy details in a separate note to Connor (she's copied). Procurement noted they need the SOC2 summary — Evelyn, if you can share the packet (or a DOC link) that would be ideal.

See you Tue & Wed.

Samir

Attachments: (calendar invite attached)
